name: active_skill_passive_combos
description: Every Active skill cast with every Unique Passive at once, again without Oath of Silence, then with two seeded random sets of 5 passives each. Looks for errors, stuck casts and broken hp/mp. A cast a passive blocks on purpose counts as a pass.

steps.note: every passive at once with each skill; Oath of Silence blocks skills with a cast time, which counts as a pass
every passive except Oath of Silence, so skills with a cast time also run with the other passives
two seeded random sets of 5 passives per skill

steps.name: no errors across every skill and passive combo
